Postman Collection Description (GoodHamburger API)

GoodHamburger API – Postman Collection

This Postman collection provides a full set of requests to test the backend API of the GoodHamburger project — a simple ordering system for sandwiches and extras.

🔍 What this collection contains

Requests to retrieve the menu (sandwiches + extras)

Requests to list only sandwiches or extras

Endpoints to create, update, list, and soft-delete orders

Example JSON payloads for creating and updating orders

✅ Purpose & Usage

Use this collection to:

Validate that the API is correctly deployed and connected to the database

Test the core business logic (ordering, extras, discounts, order updates)

Verify database seeding and data consistency after Docker startup

Serve as a baseline for functional tests, allowing collaborators to quickly test endpoints without building a frontend

🚀 How to use

Import the collection into Postman (Import → Raw text / or File)

Ensure the backend API is running (local or via Docker), and note the base URL (e.g. [http://localhost:5000](http://localhost:5000))

Adjust environment or base URL in Postman if needed

Run individual requests or create a Postman “Environment” for easier switching between local, docker, or production setups

ℹ Notes

The sample Create Order and Update Order requests use placeholder IDs — you may need to adjust them depending on your seeded data
